hadiths.english_translation: Regarding the saying of Allah the Exalted: 'And your Lord has decreed that you not worship except Him' (Surah Al-Isra 17:23). Qatadah said: 'They were commanded not to worship except Allah.'

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ , فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : وَقَضَى رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوا إِلا إِيَّاهُ سورة الإسراء آية 23 , قَالَ : " أُمِرُوا أَلا يَعْبُدُوا إِلا اللَّهَ " *

hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Qatadah: 'In the recitation of Ibn Mas'ud: 'And your Lord has enjoined that you worship none except Him.''

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ : " فِي حَرْفِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ " وَوَصَّى رَبُّكَ أَلا تَعْبُدُوا إِلا إِيَّاهُ *

hadiths.english_translation: Regarding the saying of Allah the Exalted: 'Indeed, He is ever to those who oft-return (al-awwabin) Most Forgiving' (Surah Al-Isra 17:25). Qatadah said: 'To the obedient, the praying ones.'

potential_issues.issue: قتادة is a known mudallis (category 3) using 'an (عَنْ)
potential_issues.impact: قتادة is classified as a mudallis by Ibn Hajar (category 3), and here uses the ambiguous term 'an (عَنْ). However, قتادة is generally considered highly reliable (Thiqah Thabt), so this does not significantly affect the grade. Direct transmission terms would be preferred.

hadiths.arabicText: عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ , فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ لِلأَوَّابِينَ غَفُورًا سورة الإسراء آية 25 , قَالَ : " لِلْمُطِيعِينَ الْمُصَلِّينَ " *

hadiths.english_translation: From al-Thawri and Ma'mar, from Yahya ibn Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, he said: 'Al-awwab is the one who sins, then repents, then sins, then repents, then sins, then repents.'
hadiths.arabicText: عَنِ الثَّوْرِيِّ ، ومَعْمَرٍ ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ , قَالَ : " الأَوَّابُ : الَّذِي يُذْنِبُ ، ثُمَّ يَتُوبُ , ثُمَّ يُذْنِبُ ، ثُمَّ يَتُوبُ , ثُمَّ يُذْنِبُ ، ثُمَّ يَتُوبُ " *

hadiths.english_translation: From al-Thawri, from Mansur, from Mujahid, he said: 'Al-awwab is the one who remembers his sins in solitude and seeks forgiveness from Allah for them.'
hadiths.arabicText: عَنِ الثَّوْرِيِّ ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ , عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ , قَالَ : " الأَوَّابُ : الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ ذُنُوبَهُ فِي الْخَلاءِ ، فَيَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ مِنْهَا " *

hadiths.english_translation: We were informed by Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Ubayd ibn Umayr, regarding the saying of Allah the Exalted: 'Indeed, He is ever to those who oft-return (al-awwabin) Most Forgiving' (Surah Al-Isra 17:25). He said: 'We used to count al-awwab al-hafiz (the preserver) as one who says: O Allah, forgive me for what I have committed in this gathering of mine.'
hadiths.arabicText: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ , عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ , عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ ، فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ لِلأَوَّابِينَ غَفُورًا سورة الإسراء آية 25 , قَالَ : " كُنَّا نَعُدُّ الأَوَّابَ الْحَفِيظَ ، أَنْ يَقُولَ : اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا أَصَبْتُ فِي مَجْلِسِي هَذَا " *

hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Qatadah, regarding the saying of Allah the Exalted: 'Then speak to them an easy word' (Surah Al-Isra 17:28). He said: 'Promise them good.' And al-Hasan said: 'Say to them an easy word.'

potential_issues.issue: قتادة is a known mudallis (category 3) using 'an (عَنْ)
potential_issues.impact: قتادة is classified as a mudallis by Ibn Hajar (category 3), and here uses the ambiguous term 'an (عَنْ). However, قتادة is generally considered highly reliable (Thiqah Thabt), so this does not significantly affect the grade. Direct transmission terms would be preferred.

hadiths.arabicText: أنا مَعْمَرٌ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ، فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : فَقُلْ لَهُمْ قَوْلا مَيْسُورًا سورة الإسراء آية 28 , قَالَ : " عِدْهُمْ خَيْرًا " ، وَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ : " قُلْ لَهُمْ قَوْلا سَهْلا " *

hadiths.english_translation: Ma'mar said, from Qatadah, regarding the saying of Allah the Exalted: 'And do not make your hand chained to your neck' (Surah Al-Isra 17:29). He said: 'Regarding spending, meaning: Do not withhold from spending, nor extend it completely.' Meaning: 'Do not be extravagant in squandering, so you sit blamed among Allah's servants and insolvent.' Meaning: 'Regretful over what has passed from you.'
hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ : أرنا مَعْمَرٌ ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : وَلا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً إِلَى عُنُقِكَ سورة الإسراء آية 29 , قَالَ : " فِي النَّفَقَةِ ، يَقُولُ : لا تُمْسِكْ عَنِ النَّفَقَةِ ، وَلا تَبْسُطْهَا كُلَّ الْبَسْطِ , " ، يَقُولُ : " لا تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيرًا ، فَتَقْعُدَ مَلُومًا فِي عِبَادِ اللَّهِ مَحْسُورًا " , يَقُولُ : " نَادِمًا عَلَى مَا فَرَطَ مِنْكَ " * E269

hadiths.english_translation: We were informed by Ma'mar, from Qatadah, regarding His saying: 'And do not kill your children for fear of poverty' (Surah Al-Isra 17:31). Qatadah said: 'They used to kill daughters out of fear of want.'

potential_issues.issue: قتادة is a known mudallis (category 3) using 'an (عَنْ)
potential_issues.impact: قتادة is classified as a mudallis by Ibn Hajar (category 3), and here uses the ambiguous term 'an (عَنْ). However, قتادة is generally considered highly reliable (Thiqah Thabt), so this does not significantly affect the grade. Direct transmission terms would be preferred.

hadiths.arabicText: أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ , فِي قَوْلِهِ : وَلا تَقْتُلُوا أَوْلادَكُمْ خَشْيَةَ إِمْلاقٍ سورة الإسراء آية 31 , قَالَ : " كَانُوا يَقْتُلُونَ الْبَنَاتِ خَشْيَةَ الْفَاقَةِ " *

hadiths.english_translation: I was informed by al-Thawri, from Khusayf, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, regarding the saying of Allah the Exalted: 'Then let him not transgress in killing' (Surah Al-Isra 17:33). He said: 'Do not kill other than your killer, and do not mutilate him. Indeed, he was aided.'
hadiths.arabicText: أَخْبَرَنِي الثَّوْرِيُّ ، عَنْ خُصَيْفٍ , عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ , فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : فَلا يُسْرِفْ فِي الْقَتْلِ سورة الإسراء آية 33 , قَالَ : " لا تَقْتُلْ غَيْرَ قَاتِلِكَ ، وَلا تُمَثِّلْ بِهِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مَنْصُورًا " *

hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Qatadah, regarding the saying of Allah the Exalted: 'Then let him not transgress in killing' (Surah Al-Isra 17:33). Meaning: 'Do not kill two men for one man.'

potential_issues.issue: قتادة is a known mudallis (category 3) using 'an (عَنْ)

hadiths.arabicText: أنا مَعْمَرٌ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ , فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : فَلا يُسْرِفْ فِي الْقَتْلِ سورة الإسراء آية 33 , يَقُولُ : " لا تَقْتُلْ رَجُلَيْنِ بِرَجُلٍ " *

hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Qatadah, regarding the saying of Allah the Exalted: 'And do not approach the wealth of the orphan except in the way that is best' (Surah Al-Isra 17:34). He said: 'They would not mix with them in wealth, nor food, nor drink, nor mount (transportation),' until was revealed: 'But if you mix with them - they are your brothers' (2:220).

hadiths.arabicText: أنا مَعْمَرٌ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ , فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : وَلا تَقْرَبُوا مَالَ الْيَتِيمِ إِلا بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ سورة الإسراء آية 34 , قَالَ : " كَانُوا لا يُخَالِطُونَهُمْ فِي مَالٍ ، وَلا مَأْكَلٍ ، وَلا مَشْرَبٍ ، وَلا مَرْكَبٍ " حَتَّى نَزَلَتْ : وَإِنْ تُخَالِطُوهُمْ فَإِخْوَانُكُمْ سورة البقرة آية 220 *

hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Qatadah, regarding the saying of Allah the Exalted: 'And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge' (Surah Al-Isra 17:36). He said: 'Do not say: I saw, when you did not see; and I heard, when you did not hear; and I knew, when you did not know.'

potential_issues.issue: قتادة is a known mudallis (category 3) using 'an (عَنْ)

hadiths.arabicText: أرنا مَعْمَرٌ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ , فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : وَلا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ سورة الإسراء آية 36 , قَالَ : " لا تَقُلْ رَأَيْتُ ، وَلَمْ تَرَ , وَسَمِعْتُ ، وَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ , وَعَلِمْتُ ، وَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ " *

hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Qatadah, regarding the saying of Allah the Exalted: 'That is better and best in outcome' (Surah Al-Isra 17:35). He said: 'As a consequence and reward.'

potential_issues.issue: قتادة is a known mudallis (category 3) using 'an (عَنْ)
potential_issues.impact: قتادة is classified as a mudallis by Ibn Hajar (category 3), and here uses the ambiguous term 'an (عَنْ). However, قتادة is generally considered highly reliable (Thiqah Thabt), so this does not significantly affect the grade. Direct transmission terms would be preferred.

hadiths.arabicText: أرنا مَعْمَرٌ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ , فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : ذَلِكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَحْسَنُ تَأْوِيلا سورة الإسراء آية 35 , قَالَ : " عَاقِبَةً ، وَثَوَابًا " *

hadiths.english_translation: From Ma'mar, from Qatadah, regarding the saying of Allah the Exalted: 'And do not walk upon the earth exultantly' (Surah Al-Isra 17:37). He said: 'Do not walk in arrogance and pride, for that will not make you reach the mountains in height, nor pierce through the earth with your arrogance and pride.'

hadiths.arabicText: أرنا مَعْمَرٌ , عَنْ قَتَادَةَ , فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى : وَلا تَمْشِ فِي الأَرْضِ مَرَحًا سورة الإسراء آية 37 , قَالَ : " لا تَمْشِ كِبْرًا ، وَلا فَخْرًا , فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ لا يَبْلُغُ بِكَ أَنْ تَبْلُغَ الْجِبَالَ , وَلا أَنْ تَخْرِقَ الأَرْضَ لِكِبْرِكَ ، وَفَخْرِكَ " *
